verification_notes: Artifact extracted and mounted at /artifacts/hp-10bii-financial-calculator-claude-opus-48.html. Local smoke test returned -1,419.47 for a 30-year, $250k mortgage at 5.5% using 30 shifted N, 5.5 I/YR, 250000 PV, 0 FV, PMT.
